build.source_note: External existing source worktree; local modifications are hashed, not vendored or pushed.
build.vc_storage_note: Inline-only frozen safety snapshot interning retains every original occurrence, location and goal. Report index has exact original keys. Scheduling is separately described by vc_schedule_semantics. No source vendored.
build.branch_query_note: Directly evaluate QCP-normalized pure feasibility queries; residual queries use the original SMT path. Retain spatial strategy checking and original live state/witness generation.
build.vc_schedule_note: Residual-emitting concrete spec tests queue original proof witnesses until target execution ends; online execution/resource/instance SMT remains. Preserve first solve-request order and boundary report context; retain queued objects released by temporary accumulators. No ITP invocation.
build.modular_boundary_transfer: Local-value witness correlation, frozen input specialization, QCP ownership-only frame inference, post-resource folding, typed/evaluated strategy address compatibility. Original annotation VC retained.
build.boundary_instance_normalization: Entry inputs remain instantiated; modular boundaries retain QCP symbolic states and return-type constraints without sampling. Inline declaration sampling remains unchanged.
build.modular_boundary_policy: Symbolic contracts/invariants/assertions only; no sampling mode or compatibility toggle.

evaluation_source_snapshot.scope: Evaluator and optional spatial backend source identities; binary/runtime/input hashes are recorded by each execution.
